support.scope_note: hardware_verified covers the session, capture, waveform download and the :MEASure:SIMPle:VALue? value path only. The :MEASure:SIMPle:SOURce? readback, the per-channel snapshot (:CHANnel<n>:SWITch?), the :PRINt? reader, waveform-bundle/v1 export and the decode-list reader are documented and offline-tested, not exercised on a physical instrument. Offline waveform analysis lives in the sibling oscilloscope-waveform-analysis Skill.

hardware_evidence.note: the per-claim table is in SUPPORT.md; no single date covers every claim

known_limitations: Arming on 4.8.12.1.1.6.5: fixed for fast Ready->Stop completions and already-stopped refusals; remains firmware-scoped to 4.8.12.1.1.6.5.
Modern transfer window: bounded by ACQ:POINts? record length on 4.8.12.1.1.6.5; other firmware revisions are UNVERIFIED.
Modern WORD captures emit units=code (calibration_status=CODE_ONLY) until an external hash-bound calibration file is supplied.
Three-way voltage cross-check (level_confirmed: PASS) is hardware-verified on one ~3.04 V amplitude only; a second amplitude reference and non-zero offset direction remain UNVERIFIED.
Silent-accept classes documented in SUPPORT.md (decode content completeness, screenshot trailing bytes, legacy screen-range revalidation opt-in) remain bounded by explicit status flags.
The :PRINt? PNG reader, decode-list reader, and waveform-bundle/v1 export are documented and offline-tested only; offline waveform analysis lives in the optional oscilloscope-waveform-analysis Skill.
Status words are scoped per claim: COMPLETE proves framing/count integrity only, never physical level accuracy.
